How it is counted

Classes. The total is the classes listed in parity/inventory/juce-9.0.4-classes.json, read from JUCE's public docs. Ten modules are not fully listed yet, so the total will grow; graphics and GUI modules are the biggest missing blocks.

Verified. A ledger row with status done or mapped, backed by a passing parity scenario in CI. Classes stay in progress until a scenario proves them; .

In progress. A ledger row whose owning work package has merged code. The Rust API exists but has not been checked against JUCE behaviour.

Gaps. Deliberate omissions with a written reason, such as VST2 and audio CD burning. They count as settled, not as missing. The Projucer GUI is a tooling gap and is not in the module table.
